SMTPS::enable
       Enable SMTPS (STARTTLS for SMTP).

SYNOPSIS
       SMTPS::enable

DESCRIPTION
       Enable SMTPS (STARTTLS for SMTP)

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
       ANY_EVENT

EXAMPLES
	when CLIENT_ACCEPTED {
	    if { ([IP::addr [IP::client_addr] equals 10.0.0.0/8]) } {
		SMTPS::enable
	    }
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.5.0 --First introduced the command.
